mobile.oauth.received.note: On-device browser callback page after a validated HTTP callback, BEFORE token exchange. Do not claim the user is signed in. No code, state or identity appears.

mobile.oauth.return.note: Link on on-device callback page. Returns to the installed Local Operator app using a package-targeted control URI with no OAuth payload. Keep brand Local Operator.

mobile.oauth.invalid.note: Generic body for malformed/wrong-state on-device callback request. Never reflect the URL or explain which secret field matched.

mobile.oauth.failed.note: App sign-in failure when Android native transport or browser cannot complete. Cancellation is a separate existing state. No native error/URL/code is shown.
